gloss.sensitivity: Of the cases with the finding, the share the model flagged.
gloss.specificity: Of the cases without it, the share the model left unflagged.
gloss.positivePredictiveValue: Of the cases the model flagged, the share that have it.
gloss.negativePredictiveValue: Of the cases the model left unflagged, the share that do not.
gloss.balancedAccuracy: The mean of sensitivity and specificity.
gloss.auc: How well the model’s scores rank cases with the finding above those without, from 0.5 (chance) to 1.
gloss.accuracy: The share of cases given the reference answer.
gloss.prevalence: The share of scored cases with the finding.
gloss.coverage: The share of the reference set the model answered for.
gloss.macroF1: F1 averaged over the classes, each class counting the same.
gloss.qwk: Agreement with the reference grades, from −1 to 1; 0 is chance.
gloss.referableSensitivity: Of the items graded {threshold} or more, the share the model also graded so.
gloss.referableSpecificity: Of the items graded below {threshold}, the share the model also graded so.

subgroups.none: The task reports no result by subgroup.

subgroups.notReportedSpoken: Not reported for {group}: the group is too small to publish, or is withheld so that a smaller group cannot be worked out.
subgroups.withheldSpoken: Withheld: it rests on fewer than the minimum number of items.
subgroups.notEstimableSpoken: Not estimable: no item of this group falls in this measure’s denominator.
